correctness.rationale: Over the algebraic closure in characteristic 41, smoothness holds exactly for s²≠4. The 4x4 Cartier matrix is diagonal by the mod-5 support and has entries A(v),B(v),B(v),A(v). Exact coefficient expansion gives A=18(v+15)C and B=7(v+13)(v+15)T in F41[v]; independent finite-field Frobenius irreducibility and gcd tests show exactly the root stratification. Since semilinear iterates preserve nonzero diagonal support, geometric p-rank is the matrix rank, and a=4-rank. The published geometric isomorphism criterion is applied explicitly. The accompanying standalone verifier ran and returned VERIFY_OK; finite arithmetic is proof of exact finite identities, not a finite sample of infinite geometry.
